concept: Trued, Yard Lit keeps the track series' idea (the family's week as a signal box's lit track diagram: a terminus, ring stops, a T buffer, one lamp at now) and takes the boxes away. Only the greeting board and the tubes keep a frame; every other section stands on the page ground, opened by a rule head drawn as a siding (a terminus bar, its name, its count, a steel rule, its way on, a T buffer) and parted by an engraved seam. Coming up's plates hang under the head at their own height with their leaders running down to their stops, each carrying a second fact (its drive from home); the house's other rooms are a siding yard of ring stops; and every page ends on the line's last signal, one lamp with who answers and what today has cost, lit only while a turn is being answered. It should feel like one signal box diagram at night, not a dashboard of cards: light only where the line is live.
companions: Steel #9cc3dd is the wiring: rule heads' terminus bars and buffers, the 1px rules (#2e343b) and the rails (#566a80), the yard's ring stops and icons, links (steel, underlined only on hover), the plates' route marks and drive bearings, the box at rest (42% steel edge), the foot's ring at rest. Cyan #74e6f0 is a plan's companion: the ring stops on Coming up's rail, a plate's kind word at 80%, the ring before a plan day's numeral on the month, the date chips' month. Sage #86d9a6 is 'Now' beside the lit tick on To do, 'Answering' in the foot, and the afterglow's edge. Amber is late words, the 'Late 3' key's words and the half lamps ('needs a look'); never an outline or a ring. Graphite #15191a with a #2c3336 hairline is a plan's plate. #6dff9c is the signature where the motif needs it: the mark, Send, 'plan.' (E1 halo with a hot core), the box while someone writes, the tubes' glass, the now lamps and the lit run, the power wires (the tube's, the phone readout's), the yard's next setup stop, the foot's lamp while a turn runs, and focus.
decisions: Title: 'Tell Vera what to *plan.*', the setting the 14a lessons asked for on Trued: an instruction, not a question (the question forms are retired), one line on desktop with 'plan' and its full stop inside the lit run (E1 with a hot core: 0 0 2px #eafff1, 0 0 8px brand/.75, 0 0 22px brand/.38). On a phone 'what to plan.' is kept whole, so it breaks 'Tell Vera / what to plan.' with no orphan.

Coming up de-nested: the slate band is gone; the section opens on a rule head beside the tube and the rail is its floor. Improving on the brief: rather than standing the plates on the rail with the empty height above them, each plate hangs under the head and its 1px leader grows down to its stop (the stem spans the plate's row and the leader's), so the spare height reads as track, not graphite and not empty ground.

Plates size to content, three parts: kind ring and kind word (cyan at 80%); the name at 19px Archivo 700, 88% width, balanced, two lines at most, through the nb binding; a foot of the sunk mono time well and whom, then the drive from home behind the line's own route mark (the terminus bar on its side, 10px steel), set as the Ideas Drive column sets it: tabular DM Mono, the figures at ink weight, 'h' and 'min' in ink-2, the way in steel ('2 h 05 min NE'). Worked out in the template from the place's position as views.away_from_home estimates it, left out when unknown. The last plate's right edge now meets the rail's buffer, so the plate row and the rail end together.

Rule heads on every page's sections (Home's Coming up, To do, Lately added and the yard; Status' Who answers, Keys, Connected to; the Settings groups; Plans' month head and the list's heads; Ideas' new 'Find'): a 2x12px steel terminus with a short tail, the name at the 24px head step in Archivo 600 94%, the count in DM Sans, a 1px #2e343b rule, and a T buffer at the right edge. A head with a way on ends at it: the link sits inside the buffer with no stub between, steel and not underlined at rest. On a phone the head is a two-row grid: terminus, name, rule, link and buffer on row 1, the count under the name from its left edge.

Engraved seams (1px #20272b over a 3% white highlight, 2.25rem either side) part the sections; the To do and Lately added frames, the Status slate panels, the Settings card frame and group panels, the month board's tray and the To do board's tray are gone.

The siding yard ('Around the house'): one steel line under both columns, a ring stop for each of Wishes (each kid a link with her open count), Memory (how many things she keeps, read from the memories table), Family (people) and Settings. Under each ring its steel icon, its name and how it stands on one baseline, the count in tabular DM Mono ink-2; the whole stop is the target (the way there covers the stop, inner links stand above it), names underline only on hover or focus. Stops sit at their own width 2rem apart and the line runs on to its T buffer. Setting up is folded in: while steps are left the Settings stop is the yard's one lamp, its ring lit #6dff9c with a hot core, reading '3 to finish · Choose your own password' with the next step a link; with nothing left it is a steel ring, or an amber half lamp while something needs a look. The separate 'Finish setting up' strip and its seam are gone. Kept under both columns rather than the right column alone: the left would be the hole then.

The status foot on every page but the sign-in: under a seam, the lamp, its word, 'OpenAI gpt-6-luna' (model in DM Mono) and '$0.00 of $2.00 today' (tabular DM Mono) sit at their own widths on fixed 2.5rem steel leaders, then one rule runs to 'Status →' at a T buffer (steel, underlined only on hover). The lamp is lit #6dff9c and breathing (0 0 4px/.8, 0 0 12px/.35, 2.4s) with the word 'Answering' only while a message is under a live claim, i.e. a turn is being worked on; at rest it is a steel ring with 'Ready', an amber half lamp with the status words when something needs a look, a dashed ring when it cannot answer. A kid sees only the lamp and its word.

Phone: a one-line glass readout under the box, before the starters ('NEXT Oaks Park roller rink · Sun 13:00', 'in 2 days' added where the phone is wider), the whole strip a link to the plan's idea, lit on the name only, with a 2px lit power wire from its left end down into the starter branch's junction. Starters stay stacked; a starter lights only when focused or pressed on a phone, so the harness's resting pointer no longer lights one in the still. The month strip is a 4px trace on the phone.

To do: margin dates as one line of 12px DM Mono ('Sun 27 Sep'); 'Now' in 13px DM Sans 600 sage beside the lit tick; a 'Late 3' key between Open and Done, amber words in a steel frame, jumping to the first late one (the view has no late filter). Square ticks stay square.

Status: the case is as tall as the glass (about 12rem): the chin is gone, the tally (smaller figures, 24px) sits at the head of the well with 'Change the limit' at its end, the banks under it on a steel hairline, and the working lamps breathe, staggered. Who answers keeps its lit chain under a rule head.

Colour: the box rests on a steel edge and turns green only while someone writes; Coming up's stops are cyan rings; the rail token moved from #58697a to #566a80, a touch more steel-blue, so every rail (the line's unlit run, To do's line, the yard, the form's field rail) reads as the steel wiring it is. Home's green share is now about 60% (59.8%).
Plans list rows carry the drive fact too, and its heads are rule heads (no screenshot shows the list).

Declined, as in Headlamp: moving template reads (the plates' kind, whom, position, the deadlines, the drive estimate, the foot's spend) into views.py; a variant cannot change views. Each is marked in the template where the view would hand it over.
strengths: Home reads as one signal box diagram: the board, then one line with its lit head and plates hung on leaders, then two unboxed lists and a yard, each opened by the same siding and ended by a buffer; no box but the board and the tubes on any page now, Ideas' filters and the New idea form included.

The yard is now a dense line of facts (wish counts, what she keeps, people, setup) on one baseline, with one lamp, and it absorbed the duplicate setup strip: Home is about 1575px at 1280, down from 1670.

Light is where the line is live: 'plan.' with its hot core, the tube and its run, the phone readout's name, the yard's next setup stop, and the foot's lamp only while a turn runs. Everything at rest is steel, cyan or ink.
The rule head is one rule that holds on a phone too: the link inside its buffer, the count under the name.
The plates say something useful (the drive), set as the Ideas table sets it, and end level with the rail.
weaknesses: Green is about 60% of Home's saturated pixels, on the line: the tube, the lit run, Send and 'plan.' are most of it. Part of the drop is the rail token nudged a touch bluer, which turns the steel rails into counted colour; to the eye it is barely a change.
With the foot's lamp lit only while a turn runs, a page at rest has no green lamp in the foot: the one live light at rest is the tube's or the yard's.

The drive is estimated in the template with a flat-earth distance and a series cosine; the yard's memory count, the plates, the deadlines and the foot's spend and busy check are template reads of the database that views.py would hand over in the repository.
At widths between about 48rem and 75rem the yard's stops may wrap their facts under their names; it reads as a two-line stop there, not one baseline.
The 'Late 3' key is a jump to the first late row, not a filter: the view has no late filter.
On the narrowest phones the readout drops 'in 2 days' to keep the plan's name whole.
